author: uniquesonu
name: customizable-hero-section-with-gradient-animation
description: This React component renders a visually appealing hero section with a cycling background gradient, grid pattern, headline, call-to-action buttons, key features, and trust indicators.  It uses Tailwind CSS for styling and Lucide React for icons, creating a modern and engaging user experience. The gradient smoothly transitions between predefined color schemes at set intervals.
